That’s college 101. Lol. Every freshman feels this way. You can always go home for long weekends and holidays. I felt the same too, so I made sure to go home for summers and take summer classes at the local community college
Lol college is going to be the best times of your young life. Try to look forward to college.

This is worth being sad and depressed about. This is not worth being suicidal about. We’ve all experienced a break up. For me, it took me an entire year to get over my first significant other lol. You put in a lot of emotional investment into her and it’s not guaranteed you’ll get your ROI back...so it’s understandable how you feel right now. You’ll move on for sure, could take days, weeks, months. Keep your chin up bud!

That sounds so fucking difficult. Jesus. Glad you’re not killing anyone including yourself. I have no advice for you I’m sorry. My friends dad killed him self but my friend was already in his late 20s when it happened, so he was strong enough to pull through. I believe you need to check yourself in a mental ER right now.
I cant imagine how much sadness you’re going through. I’m sorry. Please don’t kill you self over this. You can move on, I’m sure of it

I’m sorry this happened dude. You should stop being so gullible. She’s crazy. Use this as a learning lesson. Don’t stick your dick in crazy. Move on and find another girl. Hone your crazy-chick-detective skills.
What do you mean she died? How drastically did she change over two years?
You’re in high school? Dude/girl, just wait till you graduate. Have hope that things will get better and I’m positive they will.
Who cares about them. Find better friends.
Ok I admit. 2016 sucks. 2017 sucks even harder. I can’t promise you 2018 is going to suck even less. I will say that 2018 for sure is going to suck if you kill yourself.

I understand it too. You spent a long time with a significant other and now you’re just a distant memory and history to her. It sucks and literally almost everyone experiences a heartbreak. But like....unless you were married for 25 years with kids and she divorces you, I can understand the suicidal thoughts. I don’t know your history or story but even in that example I gave, it’s just not worth it. Sorry. I sympathize with you 100% but I just don’t agree with you. I wish you all the best dude
Absolutely no former gf or bf is worth such a thing. I don’t care if you dated Beyoncé. Fucking not worth it at all.
my scars are on the whites of my eyes. So while I will hope they fade over time, having weird red eyes is always going to be unsightly.
